name: Segment with ROIs
summary: Segments one or more tracts from a tractogram by applying user-written ROI inclusion and exclusion criteria (any, all, either end, both ends) with wma_pyTools, and outputs a WMC.
description: Each request line names an ROI from the input ROI collection, an operation (any, all, either_end, both_end) and whether streamlines must or must not meet it; the criteria are combined to select streamlines for each named tract, and the result is saved as a white matter classification. Use it for custom ROI-based bundle dissection. The ROIs must be in the same space as the tractogram. The README is an unfilled template.

inputs.description: Collection of ROI NIfTI files referenced by name in segRequests.

outputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) with the requested tracts.

parameters.description: What to name the requested tract(s).  BE SURE TO ENTER MULTIPLE NAMES IF YOU'RE REQUESTING MULTIPLE TRACTS

The performance of a segmentation is based on the application of some number of segmentation criteria.  Each segmentation criteria is composed of the following:

1.  ROI name:  the name of the specific, desired ROI that is found in the input ROI datatype.

2.  The requested operation, which may be one of the following: 

>  "any" : any point is within tolerance from ROI. The "default" operation.
>  "all" : all points are within tolerance from ROI.
>  "either_end" : either of the end-points is within tolerance from ROI
>  "both_end" : both end points are within tolerance from ROI.

3.  Whether or not the streamlines meeting the operation criteria should be retained or excluded.  True = keep, False = exclude.

You can perform a single segmentation or multiple segmentations with this app.

To perform a **single segmentation** (e.g. to obtain one tract), each criterion should be entered on a separate line.  Each component of a criterion should be separated by a space.  As an example:

endpoint_ROI1 either_end true
exclusion_ROI1 any false
waypoint_ROI1 any true

To perform a **multi segmentation** (e.g. to obtain multiple tracts), each set of criteria (for distinct tracts) should be on separate lines.  Within each line (and thus for each tract) each individual criterion should separated by a semicolon (;).  Each component of a criterion should be separated by a space.  As an example:

endpoint_ROI1 either_end true;exclusion_ROI1 any false;waypoint_ROI1 any true
endpoint_ROI2 either_end true;exclusion_ROI2 any false;waypoint_ROI2 any true
endpoint_ROI3 either_end true;exclusion_ROI3 any false;waypoint_ROI3 any true
parameters.placeholder: endpoint_ROI1 either_end true;exclusion_ROI1 any false;waypoint_ROI1 any true endpoint_ROI2 either_end true;exclusion_ROI2 any false;waypoint_ROI2 any true endpoint_ROI3 either_end true;exclusion_ROI3 any false;waypoint_ROI3 any true
